profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz, also known as a16z, is a venture capital firm in Silicon Valley, California, according to its website. The firm describes itself as investing in founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology, and its site carries the phrase "Software Is Eating the World." It was founded in 2009, is headquartered in Menlo Park, California, United States, and operates for profit.

No lawsuits are listed against the firm. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 236.
